description: ADO-VIEW Sort grammar on a client static read-only Recordset of SELECT ID, L, S, Dt, Y, M, B FROM T: nineteen Sort strings (L, L ASC, L DESC, S, S DESC, "S, L DESC", "L DESC, S ASC", [S], a trailing comma, an unknown field, "L DESC DESC", lower-case "l desc", extra spaces, Dt, Y, the Memo M, the Binary B, an empty string, Null); each assigned, read back, and the ID, L, S of every row read in cursor order. Asks which sort expressions are accepted, how Null, case and Memo/Binary fields order, and what an empty Sort restores.
retentionNote: Designed r-ado-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
